content:
Are you using LLMs+Lean to automatically formalize mathematical theorems? We’re building a tool that helps quantify uncertainty in LLM driven auto-formalizations, so you can better spot likely errors and decide when to trust the output.

We’re adapting our NeurIPS 2025 paper, “Grammars of Formal Uncertainty: When to Trust LLMs in Automated Reasoning Tasks,” to work with Lean. The method was originally developed for SMT-LIB, and PROLOG and we’re now extending it beyond that ecosystem to make it useful to the broader community. This was the most common request we heard during our NeurIPS presentation.

If you’re open to trying it, we’d love your feedback. I’ll personally work with you to make sure it fits your workflow and works the way you need it. Thanks!
